references.matching_note: The source and target are commutative unital rings with a unital ring map.
Finite presentation here is the ring-map/R-algebra sense, not module finite presentation.
The complex is explicitly the relative naive cotangent complex of the ring map.
The target comparison object is finite projective as an S-module.

references.phrase: quasi-isomorphic to a finite projective S-module
references.context: Homological algebra: quasi-isomorphism of complexes inducing isomorphisms on homology
references.reason: A quasi-isomorphism is a homological-algebra notion, not mere isomorphism of modules.

references.context: Homological algebra: chain complex concentrated in degree zero
references.reason: This is a degree-support condition on the comparison complex.

review_rationale: Reviewed smoothness of a commutative ring map using existing ring finite presentation, relative naive cotangent complex and finite projective module, retaining homological quasi-isomorphism and degree support.
